title: 6.3 Where Are You Going?
unit_outcome: Name places in town, say how you travel and where places are, ask for and give directions, and read bus and train times.
goal: Ask Wohin gehst du? and answer Ich gehe zum Einkaufszentrum.
grammar_function: Wohin gehst du? Ich gehe zum/zur + place.
speaking_outcome: Ask and say where someone is going.
